studies.title: Ino Tadataka's survey of Japan
studies.caption: A retired merchant walks Japan's coasts for seventeen years, measuring by pacing, rope and stars, and his team finishes the map after his death.
studies.prompt: Low side view on a Japanese coastal road about1810: Edo-period survey team laying a measuring rope along the shore, observer with a simple sighting instrument on a portable stand, pine trees and inlet beyond. Practical robes and straw hats, no modern theodolite or motor vehicles.
